description: This file defines locator generator functions and classes for different programming languages (JavaScript, Python, Java, C#, JSONL) used in the Playwright testing framework. It includes parsing, stringifying, and generating code snippets for locators based on selectors, with support for various locator types and options.

classes.name: JavaScriptLocatorFactory
classes.description: Generates locator strings for JavaScript/TypeScript using Playwright's locator API.

classes.name: PythonLocatorFactory
classes.description: Generates locator strings for Python using Playwright's locator API.

classes.name: JavaLocatorFactory
classes.description: Generates locator strings for Java using Playwright's locator API.

classes.name: CSharpLocatorFactory
classes.description: Generates locator strings for C# using Playwright's locator API.

classes.name: JsonlLocatorFactory
classes.description: Generates locator strings in JSONL format for Playwright locators.

methods.name: generateLocator
methods.description: Creates a locator string based on base, type, body, and options for each language.

methods.name: chainLocators
methods.description: Joins multiple locator strings into a chain.

methods.name: regexToString
methods.description: Converts a RegExp object into a language-specific string representation.

methods.name: toCallWithExact
methods.description: Generates code for locator methods with optional exact matching.

methods.name: toHasText
methods.description: Converts a string or RegExp into a locator filter string for hasText.

methods.name: toTestIdValue
methods.description: Converts a string or RegExp into a test ID locator value.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Escapes and quotes a string for code generation.
